name: Z-Push Detection Suite
summary: Rejected logins, password spraying from one or many addresses, account takeover (a new device after failures, several new devices at once), mailbox download by a new device, bursts of mail sent, new devices, remote wipes, attack tools and mail server outages from Z-Push, the ActiveSync gateway, whose log Wazuh does not decode at all.
summary_zh: Z-Push（ActiveSync 閘道）的登入被拒、來自單一或大量位址的密碼噴灑、帳號被接管（失敗後出現新裝置、同時出現多個新裝置）、新裝置大量下載信箱、短時間大量寄信、新裝置、遠端抹除、攻擊工具與郵件伺服器中斷；Wazuh 內建完全不解碼它的記錄。
notes: Wazuh 4.14.7 has no decoder for Z-Push. On two production Z-Push hosts (about 28,000 log lines a day between them) nothing was decoded; the only alerts those hosts raised from web traffic were the built-in POST flood rule 31533 (level 10), 50 to 140 a day on one host, every one of them ordinary phone synchronisation.

Z-Push sits between the phones and the mail server, so the mail server sees the Z-Push host as the client of every ActiveSync session. The Zimbra backend passes the phone's address along (Zimbra logs it first in oip= and as devip= in the user agent, with the last six characters of the device id), but the full device id and the result the phone received are only in the Z-Push log. A lockout or block keyed on the client address at the mail server hits the Z-Push host, which is every phone at once.

Logins come from the request summary Z-Push writes at the end of every request, the only line with the client address, the account, the device and the HTTP result. A rejected ActiveSync login is level 5; eight for one account within five minutes level 10; rejected logins for eight different accounts from one address within ten minutes (password spraying) level 10; twenty rejected logins within ten minutes on one host, each for another account and from another address (spraying from many addresses, as in Microsoft's DEV-0343 report) level 10; a successful login afterwards level 11 for that account and level 12 from the spraying address. Autodiscover logins are counted the same way, separately. Addresses sent as ::ffff:a.b.c.d by a dual-stack web server are decoded as plain IPv4.

Successful logins: ActiveSync authenticates every request, so a phone logs in hundreds of times a day, mostly from public carrier addresses (measured: 117 to 615 successful requests a day from public addresses on two hosts). Each is recorded at level 2 and does not alert. What alerts: the first time this manager sees an account used with a device id, level 3 from a private address and level 5 from a public one (the device id, not the address, because a phone changes carrier address several times a day; requests without a device form one pair per account); a built-in administrator account (admin, administrator, root, postmaster, zimbra) using ActiveSync at all, level 3 from a private address and level 8 from a public one, at most once an hour each; and a success after repeated failures (above). Measured on nine days of two hosts: 6 first-seen alerts on the first day, then 4 in eight days. On a new installation every device in use alerts once. Private means 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, fc00::/7 and fe80::/10; nothing in the pack names a host, an address or an account of a site.

A phone with an outdated saved password fails exactly like an attacker, for as long as nobody fixes it: the single-account rule then fires once per eight failures. The spraying rule needs different accounts, but Wazuh cannot count distinct values, so two such phones behind one carrier NAT address also reach it (in the sandbox after seven failures each); the many-address rule needs about a dozen failing at the same time. Private and carrier-grade NAT ranges are listed in etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses and raise a separate rule that no active response is attached to. The Zimbra backend answers four refusals that are not a wrong password with the same HTTP 401: an expired auth token, ActiveSync switched off for the account, a failed second factor, and Z-Push missing from zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs (then every login fails). Their request summaries are recorded at level 2 and never counted, so a mail server that stops trusting the Z-Push host cannot make every account look brute-forced or have real users' carrier addresses blocked.

Devices: a new device registered for an account is level 5. Remote wipe: a device with a pending wipe connecting is level 6, the wipe sent to it level 8, the device confirming it level 10. A changed device policy is level 3. Z-Push 2.7 has no device allow or block list; the closest is the ActiveSync switch of a Zimbra account, and a device refused because of it is level 5.

1.3, account takeover through ActiveSync: whoever has an account's password can add a client of his own, which this manager sees as a device id it has never seen, usually from a public address. A device first seen from a public address after three or more rejected logins for the same account within 15 minutes (from any address, ActiveSync or autodiscover) is level 12, and so is one after a brute-force alert (otherwise level 11). Three devices never seen before used by one account within 15 minutes are level 10, or 12 when the last one comes from a public address. Measured on two hosts in ten days: one device per account and no second one, while each account used 6 to 11 public addresses, about one new one a day and never two within an hour; that is why the pack counts devices, not addresses (the Zimbra pack counts new addresses from the mail server's own log). Requests without a device id (OPTIONS, a monitoring probe, the Z-Push webservice) now raise first-seen rules of their own, 132264 and 132265, at the same levels, and are not counted as devices. One case raises 132266 for a real user: three typing errors while setting up a phone outside the office. Windows are 15 minutes because analysisd only remembers its last 8,192 events, 15 to 20 minutes on a busy manager.

1.3, mailbox download by a new device (T1114.002): request counts are no measure of it. One ordinary iPhone made 196 Sync requests in a minute and 251 in 15 minutes while catching up a folder (the iOS mail app asks for 25 items at a time), while PEAS asks for 512 and needs ten requests for 5,000 messages. The pack reads what Z-Push itself logs at the start of every Sync of a folder in its diff backends (Zimbra, IMAP, Maildir, CalDAV and CardDAV; not Kopano or grommunio): how many items the device does not have yet. On two hosts in ten days the largest folder a phone synchronised held 2,640 messages and the largest count was 2,386 (an iPad catching up an archive folder); 5,000 or more in one folder is recorded at level 2, and raised within 15 minutes after the account was first seen with a new device: level 8 from a public address, 5 from a private one, 13 when that login was itself suspicious (a new device after rejected logins, a login from a spraying address, several new devices; not a success after a brute force on a known device, which is what an owner re-adding the account after a password change looks like). At most once every 30 minutes, since the count is logged again with every Sync until the folder is complete. A new phone set up for an account whose folders hold more than 5,000 messages within the phone's sync period raises it once. The agent group keeps those count lines (none on the measured data).

1.3, sending: a hijacked account is used to send phishing to colleagues and partners who trust the sender (T1534). ActiveSync sends one message per SendMail, SmartReply or SmartForward request, and the request summary names the command; each is recorded at level 2, and 20 within ten minutes for one account are level 10, one message every 30 seconds, faster than anyone writes on a phone. No phone sent anything through ActiveSync on the two hosts in ten days (0 of 39,450 requests), so the threshold comes from people, not from data. ActiveSync 16 can also send through Sync, which this does not see; the Zimbra backend speaks 14.1.

1.3, the Z-Push webservice (what the Kopano and grommunio WebApp mobile device plugins call): removing a device partnership is level 6 (it also removes the record of a device an intruder added), requesting a remote wipe level 7, one account managing another account's devices level 8, and the same refused for lack of rights level 8; Z-Push answers that refusal with the same 401 as a wrong password, and the pack does not count it as one. None occurred on the measured site, which has no WebApp.

1.3, groups for other packs (jt-account-guard): every successful login carries jt_auth_success and every failed one jt_auth_failure, once per attempt: the request summary of ActiveSync (each successful request is a login, about 4,000 a day on two hosts, all level 2 unless a rule above raises them) and the autodiscover failure line, never the LOGAUTHFAIL or exception line of the same request. Z-Push locks nothing, so jt_auth_lockout is not used. The pack's own counting rules now use pack groups instead of if_matched_sid, because in Wazuh 4.14.7 an event whose rule is named by an if_matched_sid is invisible to every if_matched_group search, and each tagged rule has a single parent, because a rule under two parents is counted twice (checked in the sandbox: under two parents the autodiscover brute-force rule fired at the fifth failure instead of the eighth).

Availability: every request that cannot reach the mail server is recorded; ten in ten minutes on one host is level 7 (at most every 30 minutes), sixty in an hour level 10. A routine mail server restart produced five in two minutes on one host, below the threshold. Zimbra refusing the Z-Push server (not in zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs, every login fails) is level 10, its DoSFilter throttling it level 7, a failed second factor (with two-factor authentication a device must use an application code) level 5. Loop detection is level 3 (about eight a day on two hosts), other fatal errors level 3, ten of them in ten minutes level 7.

At the default LOGLEVEL_INFO most of the log is folder exports, message lists and waiting for changes. Those stay at level 0, and the agent group drops them before they leave the host: on one real day 91 per cent of the lines (28,054 to 2,528 on two hosts). What remains is mostly the request summaries, at level 0 unless they follow failures.

Web server access log: phones synchronise in bursts (one tablet sent 55 POSTs in 20 seconds), which the built-in rule 31533 reports as a likely bot at level 10. Rule 132280 stops it counting successful ActiveSync POSTs. A rejected one still alerts through the built-in 400 rule 31101 (level 5), so where the access log is collected a rejected login appears twice. The access log also has the user agent of every request: an ActiveSync or autodiscover POST from a scripting or attack tool (PEAS, pyActiveSync, python-requests, curl, PowerShell, Go and similar) is level 8, and a POST claiming DeviceType iPhone or iPad without an Apple user agent (PEAS defaults to iPhone) level 7. On nine days of two hosts there were four user agents (the monitoring probe and three Apple and Android mail apps) and no mismatch in 16,756 iPhone and iPad POSTs.

PREREQUISITES: LOGLEVEL at least LOGLEVEL_INFO (the default), because the request summary is an informational line. The pack reads the file log (LOGBACKEND filelog, the default) or Z-Push's syslog backend, and also the copy rsyslog makes of the file with imfile. Read z-push.log, not z-push-error.log, which repeats its warnings and errors. Behind a reverse proxy, set USE_CUSTOM_REMOTE_IP_HEADER in Z-Push, or every address in the log is the proxy's.

Deliberately not done: the LOGAUTHFAIL line of ActiveSync and the fatal exception of a rejected request are recorded but not counted, because the request summary already counts that request; no active response is offered for the single-account rule, whose address is often a phone's carrier NAT address, nor for the many-address rule, where blocking the last address achieves nothing; the line announcing a new device has no address (the request summary that follows it has); a successful request is not graded by its address alone, since that would alert on every request of a phone on mobile data; browser user agents are not graded (spraying kits use them, but so may legitimate apps, and nothing measured them); there is no user agent allow list, because a tool alerts once per account ever; and no rule on the logged Z-Push version, because CVE-2025-8264 (fixed in 2.7.6) needs the IMAP backend with IMAP_FROM_SQL_QUERY, which the log does not show. Not done in 1.3: new public addresses per account (a phone changes address about once a day; the fts key can hold the device or the address, not both, and the Zimbra pack counts addresses from the mail server's log); bursts of GAL searches, attachment fetches (ItemOperations, GetAttachment) or document fetches, of which ten days of real data hold none, so there is no measured normal to set a threshold from; data-centre or VPN sources, which no generic list identifies (jt-ioc covers threat feeds); and policy key mismatches, a cancelled wipe or z-push-admin actions, which Z-Push logs only at DEBUG or not at all.

Attack tooling in the Z-Push log: the first time this manager sees an account used by a scripting or attack tool (Z-Push logs the user agent before every exception and for every GET, which is how EASSniper tests passwords) is level 6, later requests of the same pair level 2, so a monitoring script or an administrator testing with curl alerts once. A document library search (PEAS probes file shares this way; phones do not) is level 8 with backends that log it (not the Zimbra backend, which accepts the search and returns nothing). A login or account name shaped like an injection (a quote followed by SQL syntax, LDAP filter syntax, "../", "${", a backtick, an HTML tag; CVE-2025-8264 was an SQL injection through the login) is level 8 when the request ends in an error and level 12 when it succeeds; a rejected one stays a counted failed login, so that a junk account name cannot hide password guessing from the brute-force rules. Z-Push does not filter login names, and the decoders read the address and the HTTP result from the end of the line: up to 1.1 an account name could contain from='<any address>' and have that address decoded, and blocked by the active response.

Tested with 191 cases in a Wazuh 4.14.7 sandbox: the routine stream, a mail server restart and the user agents are real lines from Z-Push 2.7.6 with the Zimbra backend (revision 75); rejected logins, refusals, wipes, new devices and the attack tooling are built from the Z-Push 2.7.6, Zimbra backend, PEAS and EASSniper source, since none occurred in the nine days of logs available. wazuh-logtest does not apply ignore=, so the at-most-every-N-minutes limits were not observable there; first-seen pairs were (logtest keeps them per session). The agent group's filters and line joining were checked with the sandbox's own log collector. 1.3 adds 44 cases: account takeover, bulk download, sending, the webservice and the device-less first-seen rules are built from the Z-Push 2.7.6 source (index.php, exportchangesdiff.php, sendmail.php, the webservice classes), the largest real export count (2,386) is a near miss, and a sandbox-only probe confirmed that a rule of another pack searching jt_auth_success or jt_auth_failure counts each Z-Push attempt once. The agent group's new keep patterns were checked with the sandbox's own log collector.

grommunio-sync, the maintained fork of Z-Push, writes the same log format and request summary (its lib/log/filelog.php and index.php), to /var/log/grommunio-sync/grommunio-sync.log by default. When the login and the mailbox differ it writes [mailbox#login] where Z-Push writes [login#mailbox], so the decoded account is the mailbox. Checked against the grommunio-sync source, not against a running installation.
notes_zh: Wazuh 4.14.7 沒有 Z-Push 的解碼器。兩台正式的 Z-Push 主機（合計每天約 28,000 行記錄）沒有任何一行被解碼；這兩台因網頁流量產生的告警只有內建的 POST 洪水規則 31533（level 10），其中一台每天 50 到 140 筆，全部都是手機的正常同步。

Z-Push 位於手機與郵件伺服器之間，所以郵件伺服器看到的每個 ActiveSync 連線的用戶端都是 Z-Push 主機。Zimbra 後端會把手機的位址轉送過去（Zimbra 記在 oip= 的第一個位址，以及 user agent 裡的 devip=，另附裝置 ID 的最後六個字元），但完整的裝置 ID 與手機收到的結果只在 Z-Push 的記錄裡。在郵件伺服器上依用戶端位址鎖定或封鎖，擋到的是 Z-Push 主機，也就是所有手機。

登入判斷取自 Z-Push 在每個請求結束時寫的請求摘要，那是唯一同時有用戶端位址、帳號、裝置與 HTTP 結果的一行。ActiveSync 登入被拒為 level 5；同一帳號五分鐘內八次為 level 10；同一位址十分鐘內有八個不同帳號被拒（密碼噴灑）為 level 10；同一主機十分鐘內有二十次被拒、每次都是不同的帳號與不同的位址（從大量位址噴灑，如微軟 DEV-0343 報告所述）為 level 10；之後登入成功，同一帳號為 level 11，來自噴灑位址則為 level 12。autodiscover 的登入以同樣方式另外計算。雙堆疊網頁伺服器以 ::ffff:a.b.c.d 形式送來的位址，會解碼成一般的 IPv4。

成功登入：ActiveSync 每個請求都要驗證，所以一支手機一天會登入數百次，而且大多來自電信的公開位址（實測兩台主機：每天有 117 到 615 個成功請求來自公開位址）。每一次都以 level 2 記錄、不告警。會告警的是：這台 manager 第一次看到某帳號搭配某個裝置 ID，來自私有位址為 level 3、來自公開位址為 level 5（用裝置 ID 而不是位址，因為手機一天會換好幾次電信位址；沒有裝置的請求則每個帳號算一組）；內建的管理者帳號（admin、administrator、root、postmaster、zimbra）用到 ActiveSync，來自私有位址為 level 3、公開位址為 level 8，各自最多每小時一次；以及多次失敗後的成功（見上）。以兩台主機九天的資料實測：第一天 6 筆首次出現的告警，之後八天共 4 筆。全新安裝時，每個使用中的裝置都會告警一次。私有位址指 10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、fc00::/7 與 fe80::/10；套件裡沒有任何站台的主機、位址或帳號名稱。

手機存著過期的密碼時，失敗的樣子和攻擊者完全一樣，而且會持續到有人修正為止：單一帳號的規則會每八次失敗觸發一次。噴灑規則需要不同的帳號，但 Wazuh 無法計算不重複的值，所以同一個電信 NAT 位址後面有兩支這樣的手機也會觸發（沙箱實測：各失敗七次後）；大量位址的規則則要大約十來支同時失敗。私有網段與電信級 NAT（CGNAT）網段列在 etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses，觸發的是另一條沒有掛主動回應的規則。Zimbra 後端對四種不是密碼錯誤的拒絕，回的也是同樣的 HTTP 401：auth token 過期、帳號關閉了 ActiveSync、第二因素驗證失敗，以及 Z-Push 不在 zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs（此時所有登入都會失敗）。這些請求的摘要以 level 2 記錄、永不計數，所以郵件伺服器不再信任 Z-Push 主機時，不會讓每個帳號看起來都在被暴力破解，也不會讓真實使用者的電信位址被封鎖。
裝置：帳號註冊了新裝置為 level 5。遠端抹除：有待抹除的裝置連線為 level 6，抹除指令送出為 level 8，裝置回報已抹除為 level 10。裝置原則變更為 level 3。Z-Push 2.7 沒有裝置允許或封鎖清單；最接近的是 Zimbra 帳號的 ActiveSync 開關，因此被拒絕的裝置為 level 5。

1.3，透過 ActiveSync 接管帳號：拿到帳號密碼的人可以加入自己的用戶端，這台 manager 看到的就是一個從沒見過的裝置 ID，而且通常來自公開位址。同一帳號在 15 分鐘內被拒三次以上（任何位址，ActiveSync 或 autodiscover 皆算）之後，出現一個從公開位址首次出現的裝置，為 level 12；在暴力破解告警之後出現也是（否則為 level 11）。同一帳號在 15 分鐘內用了三個從沒見過的裝置為 level 10，最後一個來自公開位址時為 12。兩台主機十天的實測：每個帳號一個裝置、沒有第二個；但每個帳號用過 6 到 11 個公開位址，大約每天一個新的、從沒有一小時內出現兩個；所以套件計算的是裝置而不是位址（新位址由 Zimbra 套件從郵件伺服器自己的記錄計算）。沒有裝置 ID 的請求（OPTIONS、監控探測、Z-Push webservice）改由各自的首次出現規則 132264 與 132265 處理，等級相同，而且不算成裝置。真實使用者會觸發 132266 的情況：在辦公室外設定手機時打錯三次密碼。時間窗是 15 分鐘，因為 analysisd 只記得最近 8,192 筆事件，在忙碌的 manager 上約 15 到 20 分鐘。

1.3，新裝置大量下載信箱（T1114.002）：請求次數量不出這件事。一支普通的 iPhone 在補同步一個資料夾時，一分鐘送了 196 個 Sync、15 分鐘 251 個（iOS 郵件程式一次要 25 封），而 PEAS 一次要 512 封，5,000 封只需要十個請求。套件讀的是 Z-Push 的 diff 後端（Zimbra、IMAP、Maildir、CalDAV 與 CardDAV；Kopano 與 grommunio 沒有）在每次同步一個資料夾時自己記錄的數字：裝置還沒有的項目有幾個。兩台主機十天內，手機同步過最大的資料夾有 2,640 封，最大的數字是 2,386（一台 iPad 補同步封存資料夾）；單一資料夾 5,000 個以上以 level 2 記錄，若發生在該帳號首次出現新裝置後 15 分鐘內則告警：新裝置來自公開位址為 level 8、私有位址為 5，若那次登入本身就可疑（被拒之後出現的新裝置、來自噴灑位址的登入、多個新裝置；已知裝置在暴力破解告警後的成功登入不算，因為使用者改密碼後重新加入帳號就是這個樣子）則為 13。最多每 30 分鐘一次，因為在資料夾同步完成前，每次 Sync 都會再記錄一次數字。為資料夾在同步期間內超過 5,000 封的帳號設定新手機，會觸發一次。agent 群組會保留這些數字行（實測資料裡一行也沒有）。

1.3，寄信：被接管的帳號會被拿來寄釣魚信給信任寄件者的同事與合作夥伴（T1534）。ActiveSync 每個 SendMail、SmartReply 或 SmartForward 請求寄出一封信，請求摘要會記下指令名稱；每一封以 level 2 記錄，同一帳號十分鐘內 20 封為 level 10，也就是每 30 秒一封，比任何人在手機上寫信都快。兩台主機十天內沒有任何手機透過 ActiveSync 寄信（39,450 個請求中 0 個），所以門檻是依人的速度訂的，不是依資料。ActiveSync 16 也可以透過 Sync 寄信，這條規則看不到；Zimbra 後端用的是 14.1。

1.3，Z-Push webservice（Kopano 與 grommunio WebApp 的行動裝置外掛呼叫的介面）：移除裝置配對為 level 6（同時也會移除入侵者加入的裝置紀錄），要求遠端抹除為 level 7，某帳號管理另一個帳號的裝置為 level 8，因權限不足被拒也是 level 8；Z-Push 對這種拒絕回的是與密碼錯誤相同的 401，套件不會把它算成密碼錯誤。實測站台沒有 WebApp，一次也沒有發生。

1.3，提供給其他套件（jt-account-guard）的群組：每次成功登入帶 jt_auth_success、每次失敗登入帶 jt_auth_failure，每次嘗試只有一筆：ActiveSync 的請求摘要（每個成功的請求都是一次登入，兩台主機每天約 4,000 次，除非上面的規則提高，否則都是 level 2）與 autodiscover 的失敗行，同一請求的 LOGAUTHFAIL 行與例外行不帶。Z-Push 不會鎖定任何東西，所以不使用 jt_auth_lockout。套件自己的計數規則改用套件群組而不是 if_matched_sid，因為在 Wazuh 4.14.7 中，被 if_matched_sid 指名的規則所產生的事件，任何 if_matched_group 搜尋都看不到；而且每條帶群組的規則只有一個父規則，因為掛在兩個父規則下的規則會被算兩次（沙箱確認：掛在兩個父規則下時，autodiscover 暴力破解規則在第五次失敗就觸發，而不是第八次）。

可用性：每個連不到郵件伺服器的請求都會記錄；同一主機十分鐘內十次為 level 7（最多每 30 分鐘一次），一小時內六十次為 level 10。一次例行的郵件伺服器重啟在一台主機上兩分鐘內產生五次，低於門檻。Zimbra 拒絕 Z-Push 伺服器（不在 zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs，所有登入都會失敗）為 level 10，被 DoSFilter 節流為 level 7，第二因素驗證失敗（開啟兩步驟驗證後，裝置必須改用應用程式密碼）為 level 5。迴圈偵測為 level 3（兩台主機每天約八筆），其他致命錯誤為 level 3，十分鐘內十次為 level 7。
在預設的 LOGLEVEL_INFO 下，記錄大多是資料夾匯出、郵件清單與等待變更。這些維持 level 0，agent 群組也會在送出主機前就丟掉：以真實的一天計算丟掉 91% 的行數（兩台主機 28,054 行降到 2,528 行）。剩下的大多是請求摘要，除非跟在失敗之後，否則為 level 0。

網頁伺服器存取記錄：手機是一陣一陣地同步（一台平板 20 秒內送了 55 個 POST），內建規則 31533 會把它當成疑似機器人報 level 10。規則 132280 讓它不再計算成功的 ActiveSync POST。被拒絕的請求仍會由內建的 400 規則 31101（level 5）告警，所以有收存取記錄時，一次被拒的登入會出現兩筆。存取記錄也有每個請求的 user agent：來自腳本或攻擊工具（PEAS、pyActiveSync、python-requests、curl、PowerShell、Go 等）的 ActiveSync 或 autodiscover POST 為 level 8；自稱 DeviceType 為 iPhone 或 iPad 卻沒有 Apple user agent 的 POST（PEAS 預設就是 iPhone）為 level 7。兩台主機九天的資料只有四種 user agent（監控探測與三種 Apple、Android 郵件程式），16,756 個 iPhone 與 iPad 的 POST 沒有一個不符。

前提條件：LOGLEVEL 至少為 LOGLEVEL_INFO（預設值），因為請求摘要是資訊等級的一行。套件可讀檔案記錄（LOGBACKEND filelog，預設）或 Z-Push 的 syslog 後端，也可讀 rsyslog 以 imfile 複製的檔案內容。請讀 z-push.log，不要讀 z-push-error.log，後者重複了前者的警告與錯誤。若在反向代理之後，請在 Z-Push 設定 USE_CUSTOM_REMOTE_IP_HEADER，否則記錄裡的位址全都是代理的。

刻意不做：ActiveSync 的 LOGAUTHFAIL 行與被拒請求的致命例外只記錄不計數，因為請求摘要已經計過該請求；單一帳號規則不提供主動回應，它的位址常是手機的電信 NAT 位址，大量位址的規則也不提供，因為封鎖最後一個位址沒有用；宣告新裝置的那一行沒有位址（緊接著的請求摘要有）；成功的請求不單以位址分級，否則行動網路上的手機每個請求都會告警；瀏覽器的 user agent 不分級（噴灑工具會用，但合法的程式也可能用，而且沒有實測資料）；沒有 user agent 允許清單，因為工具對每個帳號一輩子只告警一次；也沒有依記錄裡的 Z-Push 版本告警，因為 CVE-2025-8264（2.7.6 修正）需要 IMAP 後端加上 IMAP_FROM_SQL_QUERY，而記錄看不出來。1.3 沒有做的：每個帳號的新公開位址（手機大約每天換一次位址；fts 的鍵只能放裝置或位址其中之一，而 Zimbra 套件已從郵件伺服器的記錄計算位址）；大量的通訊錄（GAL）搜尋、附件下載（ItemOperations、GetAttachment）或文件下載，十天的真實資料裡一次也沒有，沒有實測的正常值可以訂門檻；資料中心或 VPN 來源，沒有通用的清單可以辨識（威脅情資由 jt-ioc 處理）；以及原則金鑰不符、取消抹除或 z-push-admin 的操作，Z-Push 只在 DEBUG 記錄，或根本不記錄。

在 Z-Push 記錄裡的攻擊工具：這台 manager 第一次看到某帳號被腳本或攻擊工具使用時為 level 6（Z-Push 在每個例外之前與每個 GET 請求都會記錄 user agent，EASSniper 就是用 GET 試密碼），同一組合之後的請求為 level 2，所以監控腳本或用 curl 測試的管理者只會告警一次。搜尋文件庫（PEAS 用這個方式探測檔案分享，手機不會這樣做）為 level 8，只限會記錄它的後端（Zimbra 後端接受這種搜尋、回傳空結果，不會記錄）。登入名稱或帳號名稱長得像注入攻擊（引號後接 SQL 語法、LDAP 過濾語法、「../」、「${」、反引號、HTML 標籤；CVE-2025-8264 就是透過登入名稱的 SQL 注入），請求以錯誤結束時為 level 8，成功時為 level 12；被拒的仍算一次登入失敗，這樣就不能用奇怪的帳號名稱把猜密碼藏起來、躲過暴力破解規則。Z-Push 不過濾登入名稱，解碼器從行尾讀取位址與 HTTP 結果：到 1.1 為止，帳號名稱可以夾帶 from='<任意位址>'，讓那個位址被解碼出來，並被主動回應封鎖。

以 Wazuh 4.14.7 沙箱跑 191 個案例測試：例行記錄、一次郵件伺服器重啟與 user agent 是 Z-Push 2.7.6（Zimbra 後端 revision 75）的真實記錄；登入被拒、各種拒絕、遠端抹除、新裝置與攻擊工具，是依 Z-Push 2.7.6、Zimbra 後端、PEAS 與 EASSniper 的原始碼建構的，因為現有九天的記錄裡一次都沒有發生。wazuh-logtest 不套用 ignore=，所以「最多每 N 分鐘一次」的限制在那裡觀察不到；首次出現的組合則可以（logtest 依工作階段保存）。agent 群組的過濾與合併行，是用沙箱本身的記錄收集程式驗證的。1.3 新增 44 個案例：帳號接管、大量下載、寄信、webservice 與沒有裝置的首次出現規則，依 Z-Push 2.7.6 原始碼（index.php、exportchangesdiff.php、sendmail.php、webservice 類別）建構；實際資料裡最大的數字（2,386）作為不該觸發的案例；並以只放在沙箱的探測規則確認，其他套件搜尋 jt_auth_success 或 jt_auth_failure 時，每次 Z-Push 嘗試只算一次。agent 群組新增的保留樣式，是用沙箱本身的記錄收集程式驗證的。

grommunio-sync 是持續維護的 Z-Push 分支，記錄格式與請求摘要相同（見它的 lib/log/filelog.php 與 index.php），預設寫到 /var/log/grommunio-sync/grommunio-sync.log。登入帳號與信箱不同時，它寫成 [信箱#登入帳號]，Z-Push 則是 [登入帳號#信箱]，所以解碼出來的帳號是信箱。這是依 grommunio-sync 的原始碼確認的，沒有在實際運作的安裝上測過。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: zpush
agent_group.description: Z-Push's own log files (z-push.log, autodiscover.log), filtered on the agent and with the split request summary joined

setup.title: Install the pack and reload every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並重新載入所有節點
setup.body:
1. Install the pack from this page.
2. On the Rules tab, click Reload Ruleset. A cluster copies rule files to the workers but does not reload them.
setup.body_zh:
1. 在本頁安裝套件。
2. 到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集會把規則檔複製到 worker，但不會重新載入。
setup.verify: On the Rules tab, a hierarchy search for jt_zpush lists the rules of zz-132200-jt_zpush_rules.xml.
setup.verify_zh: 在「規則」分頁的階層模式搜尋 jt_zpush，會列出 zz-132200-jt_zpush_rules.xml 的規則。

setup.title: Send the Z-Push log to the manager once
setup.title_zh: 把 Z-Push 記錄送到 manager（只送一份）
setup.body:
1. On the Z-Push host, run the grep. A non-zero count means rsyslog already copies the log into /var/log/syslog: stop here, the rules read that copy. Adding the group as well sends every line twice.
2. Otherwise, on the manager, run the two commands with the host's agent ID in place of <agent_id>. Only the Wazuh agent restarts.
3. LOGFILEDIR (config.php) is not /var/log/z-push: change the two locations in the group file.
Once the log arrives, every account and device already in use alerts once (132260 or 132261).
setup.body_zh:
1. 在 Z-Push 主機執行 grep。數字不是 0，表示 rsyslog 已把記錄複製進 /var/log/syslog：到此為止，規則會讀那份。再加入群組會讓每一行送兩次。
2. 否則在 manager 上執行另外兩行指令，把 <agent_id> 換成該主機的 agent ID。只有 Wazuh agent 會重啟。
3. LOGFILEDIR（config.php）不是 /var/log/z-push：修改群組檔裡的兩個位置。
記錄開始送達後，每個已在使用中的帳號與裝置會各告警一次（132260 或 132261）。
setup.code:
grep -c ' \[ INFO\] ' /var/log/syslog    # on the Z-Push host: non-zero means rsyslog already copies the log
/var/ossec/bin/agent_groups -a -i <agent_id> -g zpush
/var/ossec/bin/agent_control -R -u <agent_id>
setup.verify: From any client: curl -sk -u nosuchuser:wrong -X POST 'https://<zpush-host>/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync?Cmd=Sync&User=nosuchuser&DeviceId=WAZUHTEST0001&DeviceType=test' — expect rule 132210 (level 5) naming nosuchuser and your address.
setup.verify_zh: 從任一台用戶端執行：curl -sk -u nosuchuser:wrong -X POST 'https://<zpush-host>/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync?Cmd=Sync&User=nosuchuser&DeviceId=WAZUHTEST0001&DeviceType=test' —— 應出現規則 132210（level 5），內容含 nosuchuser 與你的位址。

setup.title: After updating to 1.3: nothing to change
setup.title_zh: 更新到 1.3 後：不需要變更
setup.body: The updated group file reaches the agents by itself; only the Wazuh agent restarts. It now keeps the bulk-download count lines (rules 132290-132293) and the webservice device lines (132246-132248). The bulk-download rules need a diff backend (Zimbra, IMAP, Maildir, CalDAV, CardDAV); the sending rules need LOGLEVEL_INFO, the default.
setup.body_zh: 更新後的群組檔會自動送到 agent；只有 Wazuh agent 會重啟。群組現在會保留大量下載的項目數記錄（規則 132290-132293）與 webservice 的裝置管理記錄（132246-132248）。大量下載的規則需要 diff 後端（Zimbra、IMAP、Maildir、CalDAV、CardDAV）；寄信的規則需要 LOGLEVEL_INFO，也就是預設值。

setup.title: Zimbra backend: log failed autodiscover addresses
setup.title_zh: Zimbra 後端：記錄 autodiscover 失敗的位址
setup.body: Add the line to <z-push>/autodiscover/config.php, where <z-push> is the Z-Push directory. Set it there only: in the main config.php it adds a second, unneeded line for every failed ActiveSync login. Nothing needs a restart.
setup.body_zh: 把這一行加到 <z-push>/autodiscover/config.php（<z-push> 是 Z-Push 目錄）。只加在那裡：加在主設定 config.php 的話，每次 ActiveSync 登入失敗都會多一行用不到的記錄。不需要重啟任何服務。

setup.title: List addresses that must never be blocked
setup.title_zh: 列出絕不可封鎖的位址
setup.body: Add your egress addresses and proxies to etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses, one per line: an address, or a prefix ending in a dot. Then reload the ruleset. Spraying from a listed address raises 132216 or 132219 (same level, no active response) instead of 132215 or 132218. Private and carrier-grade NAT ranges are listed already; updates and removal of the pack leave the list alone.
setup.body_zh: 把自己的對外位址與代理加入 etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses，每行一個：位址，或以點結尾的前綴。然後重新載入規則集。來自所列位址的噴灑觸發 132216 或 132219（等級相同、沒有主動回應），而不是 132215 或 132218。私有網段與電信級 NAT 網段已經列入；更新或移除套件都不會動這份清單。

setup.title: Behind a reverse proxy: log the client address
setup.title_zh: 在反向代理之後：記錄用戶端位址
setup.body: In <z-push>/config.php, set USE_CUSTOM_REMOTE_IP_HEADER to the header the proxy sets. Only do this when the proxy overwrites that header, or a client can choose its logged address. Block on the proxy, not on the Z-Push host: the connections come from the proxy.
setup.body_zh: 在 <z-push>/config.php 把 USE_CUSTOM_REMOTE_IP_HEADER 設為代理伺服器設定的標頭。只有在代理會覆寫該標頭時才設定，否則用戶端可以自己決定被記錄的位址。封鎖請做在代理上，不要做在 Z-Push 主機：連線來自代理。

setup.title: Optional: collect the web server access log
setup.title_zh: 選用：收集網頁伺服器的存取記錄
setup.body: Skip this if another group or rsyslog already sends the access log of the web server in front of Z-Push. Otherwise add the localfile to the zpush group or the host's ossec.conf. It must be the Apache or nginx combined format. Only the Wazuh agent restarts.
setup.body_zh: 若別的群組或 rsyslog 已經送出 Z-Push 前面那台網頁伺服器的存取記錄，就略過這一步。否則把 localfile 加到 zpush 群組或該主機的 ossec.conf。記錄必須是 Apache 或 nginx 的 combined 格式。只有 Wazuh agent 會重啟。
setup.verify: From any client: curl -sk -A python-requests/2.31 -X POST 'https://<zpush-host>/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync?Cmd=Sync&User=nosuchuser&DeviceId=WAZUHTEST0002&DeviceType=test' - expect rule 132281 (level 8) with your address.
setup.verify_zh: 從任一台用戶端執行：curl -sk -A python-requests/2.31 -X POST 'https://<zpush-host>/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync?Cmd=Sync&User=nosuchuser&DeviceId=WAZUHTEST0002&DeviceType=test' —— 應出現規則 132281（level 8），內容含你的位址。

setup.title: Use grommunio-sync instead of Z-Push
setup.title_zh: 改用 grommunio-sync 而不是 Z-Push
setup.body:
1. In the group file, change the first location to the line below (LOGFILE in grommunio-sync's configuration).
2. If the host has no Z-Push autodiscover.log, remove the second entry.
The decoded account is the mailbox, not the login.
setup.body_zh:
1. 在群組檔把第一個位置改成下面這一行（grommunio-sync 設定裡的 LOGFILE）。
2. 主機上若沒有 Z-Push 的 autodiscover.log，刪掉第二段。
解碼出來的帳號是信箱，不是登入帳號。

active_response.title: Block an address that tries passwords on many accounts
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖對多個帳號試密碼的位址
active_response.body: After rejected logins for eight different accounts from one address within ten minutes (ActiveSync 132215, autodiscover 132218), drops that address on the Z-Push host for 30 minutes with iptables or nftables. Refusals of the mail server that are not a wrong password (expired token, ActiveSync off, second factor, Z-Push not in zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs) are not counted, and the address is the one Z-Push logged for the connection, not one an account name can write (fixed in 1.2). Addresses in etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses (private and carrier-grade NAT ranges by default) raise other rules and are never blocked. Risks: a mobile carrier's NAT address is shared by many subscribers, and two of your users with stale passwords behind the same one look like spraying after about seven failures each; blocking it cuts off every user of that carrier gateway for 30 minutes, including users who did nothing wrong. Behind a reverse proxy the block does nothing on the Z-Push host, because the connection comes from the proxy. Deliberately not offered for one account failing repeatedly (132214): that is usually a phone with a stale password.
active_response.body_zh: 同一位址十分鐘內有八個不同帳號登入被拒後（ActiveSync 132215、autodiscover 132218），在 Z-Push 主機上以 iptables 或 nftables 封鎖該位址 30 分鐘。郵件伺服器不是因為密碼錯誤的拒絕（token 過期、關閉 ActiveSync、第二因素、Z-Push 不在 zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs）不計數，封鎖的位址是 Z-Push 為這個連線記錄的位址，帳號名稱寫不進去（1.2 修正）。etc/lists/jt-zpush-trusted-addresses 所列的位址（預設為私有網段與電信級 NAT 網段）觸發的是其他規則，永遠不會被封鎖。風險：電信業者的 NAT 位址由許多門號共用，你的兩位使用者若存著過期密碼又剛好在同一個 NAT 位址後面，各失敗約七次後看起來就像噴灑；封鎖會讓該電信閘道後的所有使用者 30 分鐘內無法同步，包括沒做錯事的人。在反向代理之後，Z-Push 主機上的封鎖沒有作用，因為連線來自代理。刻意不為「單一帳號一再失敗」（132214）提供：那通常是存著過期密碼的手機。
